plan.summary: BRO-5515: finish the nonprofit-to-commercial switch audit across every season. Of the nonprofit-origin shows checked (LCT: My Fair Lady, Camelot, Oslo; MTC: Old Friends, Ink, The Little Foxes; Roundabout/2ST: 1776, Pirates!, Appropriate), only Appropriate switched: Second Stage's Hayes run closed Mar 3, 2024 and a commercial run produced by ATG, Annapurna Theatre, Bad Robot Live and others began at the Belasco on Mar 25, 2024. Its editorial recoupment month (2024-03) predates any commercial week, so it moves to the run's final month. The audit also found that Old Friends' $12M capitalization came from the Form D of 'Old Friends Broadway Limited Partnership' (CIK 1977214), which is Merrily We Roll Along's investor partnership (general partners SFP-NY, Chocolate Factory, P-Cat; $12M sold to 190 investors; Merrily recouped its $12M in Mar 2024). The revue has no reported capitalization. Plaza Suite's $8.0M is an estimate inferred from its $2,000,887 tax credit at the 25% rate (its source says so), but the record did not flag it, so /biz printed it as a reported figure: it is flagged as an estimate.
steps: recoupedDate moves to 2024-06 before or with the conversion: commercial-record-checks.js refuses a recoupedDate month before the commercial run began.
